paragraphs.text: Clem is a mousefolk from Goodhill , Bloomburrow , and Mabel 's husband.

Clem is Mabel 's husband, and father of Rosalyn, Foggy and Pip . Clem is a warm, loving, and practical individual with a strong sense of responsibility. He has a plump build, with gray fur. His eyes are bright, and he has a cheerful and lighthearted nature. He wears a green tunic, often with an apron on top. Clem is very affectionate and supportive, quick to step in and help his family. Clem's calm and steady demeanor contrasts with the more hectic energy of his children, and he seems to take everything in stride with good humor and a focus on the well-being of his family.

Clem and his children were preparing for Mabel 's birthday party. When Mabel rushed off to investigate the trouble at Pond Creek, Clem reassured her, promising to take care of the children while she was away. When Helga arrived in Goodhill, disoriented and exhausted, Clem was quick to act on Mabel's instructions, fetching Oliver , the mayor, and ensuring that Rosalyn prepared mint tea to soothe Helga. He also provided emotional support to Mabel, discussing the seriousness of Helga's visions and the potential threat posed by the Calamity Beast Maha .

Clem reassured Mabel about her decision to investigate Pondside , offering to manage their household and children in her absence, displaying his reliability and deep understanding of their shared responsibilities. His unwavering support bolstered Mabel's resolve, illustrating his integral role in their partnership and the broader community of Goodhill.

Even in his absence, Clem played a quiet yet impactful role in Mabel's story, serving as a source of strength for Mabel when she faced intense challenges like the battle with Glarb and Cruelclaw . His memory and words from the past surfaced in critical moments, helping Mabel push through life-threatening situations. Upon Mabel's return home, Clem's presence was reassuring and comforting, symbolizing the safe and loving environment that Mabel longed to return to. His humorous and affectionate demeanor also helped to ease the tension after Mabel's arduous journey, as he welcomed her back with open arms, reaffirming the strong bond within their family.
